description.zh: 版本感知的运行时兼容 shim：让第三方插件在 dsh（DeepSeek Harness）升级后无需改动继续工作。
description.en: A version-aware runtime compatibility shim that keeps third-party plugins working unchanged across dsh (DeepSeek Harness) upgrades.

description.zh: DSH 整合包管理工具：图形客户端（Electron GUI + DSH 插件）+ dspack CLI，一键导出、浏览、安装整合包。
description.en: DSH modpack management: a desktop client (Electron GUI + DSH plugin) and the dspack CLI for one-click export, browse and install.

description.zh: DSH 整合包管理插件 bundle：.dspack 导出/安装、多 profile 切换、市场浏览、工作区配置与任务中心。零官方源码改动、零第三方插件，运行时仅依赖 fflate。
description.en: DSH modpack management plugin bundle: .dspack export/install, multi-profile switching, market browsing, workspace config and a task center. Zero official-source changes, zero third-party plugins, only fflate at runtime.

description.zh: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 的壁纸变成 DSH 网页界面的背景：Video 动态播放、Web 以 iframe 加载、Scene 壁纸提取主纹理作为静态帧；iOS 液态玻璃设置窗口，可调配色、玻璃透明度、模糊与边框。
description.en: Turns your local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers into the DSH web GUI backdrop: Video and Web (iframe) wallpapers, Scene wallpapers as extracted static frames, plus an iOS-style liquid glass settings window for accent color, glass transparency, blur and border.
